Checkbox

A control that lets the user toggle between checked and not checked — for accepting terms, multi-select lists and selectable cards. Try clicking any checkbox below; they're live.

4 states 3 layouts Token-driven

Preview

States

Four states. Checked fills with secondary blue; invalid shows a danger red border; disabled drops opacity.
Uncheckedborder-strong
Checkedsecondary fill
Disabledopacity .5
Invaliddanger border

Layouts

Same control, three compositions — label only, with description, or as a selectable card.
Basic
With description
Card

Anatomy

The parts of a checkbox and the token each one is bound to.
box → --size-box (20px) radius → --rounded-sm checked fill → --color-secondary border → --color-border-strong label → --font-size-label description → --color-text-support gap → --spacing-xs focus → --shadow-focus-blue

Code

Copy-and-own — a native input + a styled box. Accessible and framework-free.
          
<Checkbox label="Accept terms" description="By clicking, you agree." checked />
<Checkbox label="Required" invalid />
<Checkbox label="Accept terms" description="Whole card is the target." card />

Guidelines

✓ Do
  • Always pair the box with a clickable label.
  • Use for multi-select — many options can be on at once.
  • Show the red invalid border only after a failed submit.
✗ Don't
  • Don't use a checkbox for one-of-many — that's a radio.
  • Don't use it as an on/off switch — that's a toggle.
  • Don't leave the box without a label (bad a11y + tiny target).
